summary: {person} asks what a funded position buys when the department cannot hire a plumber.
realLife: Seattle Parks reported difficulty recruiting plumbers because city pay competed poorly with other offers.
gates: A funded trade vacancy and a record of unsuccessful recruitment.
weights: A longer queue for plumbing repairs makes a hiring delay more visible.
inGame: needs: posted pay range, recruitment results and open trade work orders.

turns.what: The shop assigns its oldest repair to the new hire.
turns.pulledBy: A candidate accepts the current offer.
turns.writesBack: Close the recruitment and schedule the work.

turns.what: The director takes the hiring history to the budget meeting.
turns.writesBack: Attach the declined offer to the vacancy review.
